description: A four-operator FM voice from the Yamaha YM2612 of the Sega Mega Drive, with the chip's eight operator routings

params.text: Picks which of the eight routings connects the four operators, drawn above the knob
Feeds operator 1's output back into its own phase, 0 to 7
Sets the rate of the chip's internal low frequency oscillator, from 3.98Hz to 72.2Hz in eight steps
Sets the level the output is scaled to before clipping, 0 to 127
Sets how quickly that operator's envelope climbs to the level set by its Total Level, 1 to 31, higher settings taking longer
Sets the height that operator's envelope climbs to, 0 to 100, with 100 the loudest
Sets how quickly that operator's envelope falls from its peak to the sustain level, 0 to 31, higher settings taking longer
Sets the level that operator's envelope falls to and holds while its gate stays high, 0 to 15, with 15 the loudest
Sets how quickly that operator's envelope keeps falling once it has reached the sustain level, 0 to 31, higher settings taking longer
Sets how quickly that operator's envelope falls to silence after its gate drops, 0 to 15, higher settings taking longer
Sets the pitch of that operator, five octaves either side of C4
Multiplies that operator's frequency by a half, or by one to fifteen
Sets how far the internal low frequency oscillator moves that operator's level, in four steps from nothing to 11.8dB
Sets how far the internal low frequency oscillator moves that operator's pitch, from nothing up to 80% of a semitone in eight steps
Makes that operator's envelope run faster at higher pitches, 0 to 3, with 0 applying no such scaling
Switched on, that operator's envelope repeats instead of holding, turning it into a looping modulation source

inputs.text: Picks the operator routing through the ALG knob, 8V spanning all eight
Raises the feedback set by the Feedback knob, 8V spanning the whole range
Raises the low frequency oscillator rate set by the LFO knob, 8V spanning all eight steps
Scales the Saturation knob by the voltage here, 10V leaving it untouched and 0V silencing the output
Raises that operator's attack rate, the whole knob range spanning 8V
Raises that operator's total level, the whole knob range spanning 8V
Raises that operator's decay rate, the whole knob range spanning 8V
Raises that operator's sustain level, the whole knob range spanning 8V
Raises that operator's sustain rate, the whole knob range spanning 8V
Raises that operator's release rate, the whole knob range spanning 8V
Opens that operator's envelope while it is above 2V and releases it when it falls back to 0V; unpatched it takes the gate of the operator before it, and operator 1 reads 0V
Restarts that operator's envelope from its attack stage on each rise past 2V; unpatched it takes the trigger of the operator before it, and operator 1 reads 0V
Sets that operator's pitch at a volt per octave, clamped to six and a half octaves either side of C4; unpatched it takes the pitch of the operator before it, and operator 1 reads 0V
Raises that operator's frequency multiplier, 8V spanning all sixteen settings
Raises that operator's LFO amplitude sensitivity, 8V spanning the range
Raises that operator's LFO pitch sensitivity, 8V spanning all eight steps

outputs.text: Carries the voice's audio, clipped at 5V; both output jacks carry the same signal

notes: the module makes no sound until a gate above 2V reaches a GATE jack; operator 1's gate is normalled forward to the other three, so one cable there opens all four envelopes
which operators are heard and which only modulate depends on the routing set by ALG, drawn in the diagram above that knob
the six lamps down the left edge are a meter on the output, marked from +3 down to -24
menu: Soft Reset Envelope Generator — restarts an envelope from its present level rather than from zero, which removes the click at the start of a re-triggered note
